details:
Introduce an optional, account-wide privacy setting that allows VRChat users to automatically block incoming friend requests from all other users.

When enabled, other users should be unable to send friend requests to the account, without requiring the account owner to manually decline requests or block individual users.

Add a setting under VRChat's Privacy or Social settings:

**Allow Incoming Friend Requests**

- Enabled (Default): Other users can send friend requests normally.

- Disabled: All incoming friend requests are automatically prevented.

When disabled:

- The setting applies globally across all instances and worlds.

- Other users cannot submit new friend requests to the account.

- No incoming friend request notifications are generated.

- Existing friendships remain unaffected.

- The account owner can still send outgoing friend requests if they choose.

- The setting can be enabled or disabled at any time.

Ideally, the interface would indicate that the user is not currently accepting friend requests, rather than allowing requests to appear successful when they cannot be received.

Why This Feature Is Needed:

Not every VRChat user wishes to use the platform primarily for expanding their friends list.

World creators, artists, performers, and other users may enjoy making their creations publicly accessible, interacting with visitors, or hosting occasional public instances without necessarily inviting ongoing personal connections.

Currently, receiving friend requests can create unnecessary social pressure to accept, decline, or leave requests pending.

Manually declining requests or blocking individual users is not an effective substitute for a global privacy preference.

Public visibility should not automatically imply personal social availability.

Benefits:

- Gives users greater control over their social accessibility.

- Reduces unwanted friend requests and associated notifications.

- Supports world creators and public-facing users who prefer to maintain boundaries.

- Allows users to participate in public VRChat experiences without encouraging unsolicited personal connections.

- Preserves existing friendships and outgoing friend request functionality.

This would be an entirely optional privacy feature, disabled by default, so existing social behavior remains unchanged for users who enjoy receiving friend requests.

The goal is not to discourage social interaction, but to give users greater control over how they choose to participate in VRChat.

Users should be able to share their worlds, creations, and experiences publicly without being required to remain personally available for friend requests.
title: Global Privacy Setting to Disable Incoming Friend Requests
